Activate only if Local Hero has vigilance and only once. {GW}{GW}{GW}{GW}: Recruit a Citizen. Double the number of +1/+1 counters on Local Hero. It becomes a Hero in addition to its other types. Activate only if Local Hero has first strike.

card.name: Unholy Ceremony
card.text: Exile two creatures you both own and control. Then put those creatures onto the battlefield combined into one creature under your control. It has "This creature can't be blocked." (Its power is equal to their total power, its toughness is equal to their total toughness, and it has their names, mana costs, types, text boxes, etc.)

card.name: It Who Walks the Night
card.text: Deathtouch When It Who Walks the Night enters, destroy target creature. At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life. Whenever It Who Walks the Night deals combat damage to a player, return it to your hand and create a tapped Treasure token.

card.text: Overwhelming Assault deals X damage to each permanent that can be dealt damage. Recruit a Soldier X times. (To recruit, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier creature token or put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.)

card.text: Whenever Exalted Autocrat attacks, turn a face up land you control face down. If it's untapped, tap it. It becomes attacking. (Face down cards are colorless 2/2 creatures.) Whenever a face down creature you control dies, draw a card.

card.name: The Mad Wizard

(To recruit, create a 1/1 colorless Homunculus creature token or put a +1/+1 counter on each Homunculus you control.)
